notes: Doubled distributive ish echad ish echad is rendered once; the second pair is unrepresented under rule 22, and the split of the first pair across a man ... one is hedged in the echad unit's note against the reading that gives every one whole to kol.
every before tribe is a supplied quantifying determiner on an anarthrous construct noun and joins that noun's unit under rule 15, distinct from the kol later in the verse which takes its own every.
thou is placed on the 2ms suffix under rule 40, with the competing rule 17 reading (the imperative's own subject, suffix unrepresented) named in that unit's note.
